purchase_objections: In the 'checked' memo shots the Key figures table still reads FY26 outlook €71–73m, the exact kind of leftover I'd be fired for.
'Cloud AI may process document content' and 'Can make mistakes' on screen: for board and client material I need to know which cloud, what retention, and whether it can be disabled.
Is this replacing Excel/Word/PowerPoint? Do my files round-trip back to real Office with formulas, styles and our template intact?
Real recording is labelled '8x speed'; I can't tell how long the actual run took for 10 edits.
The chatbot failure is a strawman: nobody on my team regenerates a 12-slide deck in a chat to change one number; we'd fix it by hand, which is the real competitor.
No price and 'Request early access' only.
would_try: maybe — the per-element change list (Slide 4 title, TextBox 23, Revenue!E6 8.9→8.5) is the first AI-office demo that looks auditable, but I'd only try it on a copy of a real board pack.
buy_decision: TRY_FIRST — flips to BUY if I see it open my existing Office files from our drive and hand them back to Excel/PowerPoint with formulas and template intact, plus a clear statement of where document content is processed.
